subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the People of the Springs

50020101.text: We're finally here! So, this is your home, Mualani! Paimon can't wait to have a look around!

50020102.text: Ahh... See, what did I tell you? A dip in the hot springs after a battle is just the best!

50020103.text: Fetch me a bottle of wine, would you, dear?

50020104.text: Just one? Let's get another, it's still early in the day, isn't it?

50020105.text: Wanna go to Golden Dusk later?

50020106.text: Now this is a vacation... Absolutely amazing!

50020107.text: Wow, it's so lively around here! Is there some kind of holiday going on?

50020108.text: We try to treat every day like a holiday around here. We believe every day is worth celebrating.

50020109.text: Now, let me show you around. Hmm... where to start...

50020110.text: Xochicuicatl Records, Colomche Plaza... There are so many options, but I recommend starting with the real highlight around here.

50020113.text: The hot springs, of course! Natural hot springs have tons of health benefits. Go for a nice, long soak, and you're guaranteed a good night's sleep!

50020114.text: W—Wait, you want us to bathe... here?

50020115.text: Oh, don't be shy. C'mon, I'll take you to get changed—

50020118.text: Please, I've told you just "Atea" is fine. Do I look that old to you?

50020119.text: Were you taking these two to the hot springs?

50020120.text: #That's right. Oh, let me introduce you. This is {NICKNAME}, and the small one next to {M#him}{F#her} is Paimon.

50020121.text: They only just arrived in Natlan, so I'm taking them around to experience our customs!

subQuests.subQuestName: Head for the artificial hot springs

50020201.text: Oh... I see. That's a great idea. I like it!

50020202.text: See, I told you the Chief would agree!

50020203.text: Let's get moving, then! We can't let a word of this slip to anyone else...

50020204.text: Hey, Amina, Hikueru, Marokau! You three seem particularly cheerful today. What's the occasion?

50020205.text: Oh, Mualani, you're back! Umm, who are these two...?

50020206.text: #This is {NICKNAME} and Paimon, two very important guests. I wanted to take them to the natural hot springs, but Auntie Atea caught us, so we had to come here first.

50020207.text: Oh, what a coincidence! We were just talking about her.

50020208.text: We think Auntie Atea's illness has taken a turn for the better.

50020210.text: Okay, so, while you've been busy with the Pilgrimage, we noticed that she's been visiting the hot springs alone at night.

50020211.text: Specifically, the hot springs in the cave to the north of our settlement — I'm sure you know the one. Apparently, she used to go there a lot before they became abandoned for some reason.

50020212.text: She could never come into contact with hot water before, and now she's visiting the hot springs every night. I mean, it's pretty obvious what that means, right?

50020213.text: Yeah, so we got to thinking... What if we renovated the abandoned spring behind her back, then threw her a huge surprise party!

50020214.text: Chief Amina thinks it's a great idea, too. So, you want in?

50020215.text: Of course! How could you even think of pulling this off without me?

50020216.text: I'm a little busy right now, though. I'll come find you once we're done at the hot springs.

50020217.text: Of course, take your time! You should focus on our guests, for now.

50020218.text: These artificial springs are pretty new, but the experience is just as good as the natural ones, if you ask me. We really worked hard on them, so I hope you enjoy!

50020219.text: And you two... I know you want to focus on Atea's surprise, but don't forget your patrol duties in the meantime. The Abyss could attack at any moment, so we need to stay vigilant.

50020220.text: You got it, Chief. We'll keep an eye out — you can count on us.

50020221.text: Alright, we're off, then. See you at the abandoned spring, Mualani.

50020222.text: I'm also gonna head out. Have fun!

50020223.text: Finally, it's hot spring time! Oh, I already arranged swimwear for you guys, by the way. C'mon, I'll show you to the changing room.

subQuests.subQuestName: Try the artificial hot springs out

50020301.text: (Wait, why does it fit surprisingly well...?)

subQuests.subQuestName: Change into the outfit Mualani prepared

50020441.text: (Wait, why does it fit surprisingly well...?)

50020403.text: Oooph... So, what do you think? Can you feel the warmth relax every muscle in your body?

50020404.text: Yeah, it's so nice. The steam is warm too...

50020405.text: The first time I came to the hot springs, there was no calming effect whatsoever. I was such a little ball of energy, the moment my parents looked away, I ran off to the high-temperature pools.

50020406.text: It's actually pretty funny looking back on it. They were absolutely frantic, looking for me all over, until, finally, they saw my head slowly poke out from under the water.

50020407.text: I was too young to remember the whole ordeal, but my parents told me all about it. A natural-born swimmer, my mother called me. Just like her, I taught myself how to dive underwater the first time I ever went swimming.

50020408.text: So, feel free to go for a swim. I'll be right here if you need rescuing.

50020411.text: Auntie Atea! You really came to check on us?

50020412.text: Of course, and I'm glad you listened. I brought you all some milk and snacks as well — I'll just leave them here.

50020413.text: The temperature in the artificial springs isn't too high, so I went with Saurus Crackers and Grainfruit Chips. See how you like them!

50020416.text: Well, I did make them myself.

50020417.text: Very few young people know how to truly appreciate hot springs, so listen carefully. The temperature of the hot spring not only determines the types of snacks you should choose, but also the amount of time you should spend in the water.

50020418.text: To bathe in a hot spring is to completely empty your mind. As such, swimming around the pool is incredibly disruptive and impolite... and something you should absolutely not learn from Mualani.

50020420.text: Alright. Looks like you were able to adapt to the temperature no problem. You should be able to switch to the natural springs, then.

50020421.text: Well, I've got to get going. Oh, and make sure you drink your milk. I'm looking at you, Mualani. I still remember how you used to pour it into the water when you were little.

50020422.text: That better not happen again, whether I'm here to catch you or not.

50020424.text: Paimon didn't think you were the type to do something like that...

50020425.text: Haha, I remember thinking I'd totally get away with it, too! But, turns out milk is pretty easy to spot when you pour it into clear water... Not my best work.

50020426.text: You drink the milk and enjoy the hot spring with Mualani...

50020427.text: Some people get dizzy if they stay in here too long. You guys alright?

50020428.text: Paimon's fine, just a bit stuffed...

50020430.text: Looks like you two are naturals! Oh, by the way, I have to leave you on your own for a little while this afternoon. I'm gonna help the others fix up that abandoned spring.

50020431.text: I certainly don't trust their aesthetic tastes. Who knows what will become of the place if I leave them unattended?

50020432.text: In exchange, though, I can recommend a couple of shops that are worth a visit...

50020436.text: Atea has been really kind to us...

50020437.text: Yeah! She brought us snacks and taught us about the hot springs... We wanna do our part too.

50020438.text: Friends are supposed to help each other out! We'd feel bad, otherwise.

50020439.text: Well, then... The more the merrier!

50020440.text: Alright, we should get going. Let's organize the best hot spring gathering Natlan's ever seen!

subQuests.subQuestName: Meet up with Marokau and the others

50020501.text: Mualani! Wait, you brought our guests, too?

50020503.text: But, you're important guests! We can't put you to work!

50020506.text: Alright, alright. Stop trying to out-polite each other, would you? The sooner we get this party started the sooner we get to enjoy the real party!

50020507.text: Now, where to start... Hmm, looks like the water outlet is blocked pretty bad. We'll need to dig under it.

50020508.text: Those boxes in the corner need to be thrown out as well... Gah. They're moldy as all get out!

50020509.text: Also, someone needs to go out and get some cloth, wood, and decorations... Oh, and snacks, too! I say we get enough for twenty or thirty people. Bulk purchases fetch the best prices, after all... Oh, but don't just accept the first offer they give you—

50020510.text: Um... I'm not good at haggling. Why don't you go?

50020511.text: Hey, I'm not any better, and I wouldn't even know what to buy. Umm, how about we handle things here while you three deal with the shopping?

50020513.text: I can introduce you to all the shops while we're at it. Alright, let's meet back here later.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the market street to buy the necessary goods

50020601.text: Hey there, Yelafath. Hope business has been going well.

50020602.text: Well, if it isn't Mualani. Back from the Pilgrimage?

50020603.text: That's right. Didn't make the cut this year, though.

50020604.text: Well, it wouldn't be a competition if everyone got to win. So, what'll it be today?

50020605.text: Here, it's all on the list — quite a sizeable order, as you can see. So, uh... can we expect a discount?

50020606.text: Wow, that is large order. What's it all for, a party?

50020607.text: That's right. Keep this between us for now... but, we're throwing a hot spring party for Auntie Atea.

50020608.text: Wait, you're saying she can go in the hot springs again? That's great news! How about this — you can have the decorations on the house, and I'll give you twenty percent off the cloth and wood.

50020609.text: C'mon, I know you can sweeten the deal. That pile of wood's been sitting there since I left for the Pilgrimage. At this rate, you need to get rid of it or it's gonna go moldy...

50020610.text: Alright, alright... *sigh* Such a handful. Just give me a moment while I pack all this up for you.

50020612.text: Haha, all in a day's work. By the way, Yelafath, are these two stones for sale?

50020614.text: I'm not planning to haggle this time, I promise. Package them separately, would you?

50020616.text: Nope. Kachina likes shiny little trinkets, so whenever I come across something like that, I always buy it for her.

50020617.text: I'll hold onto them for now. It'll be a nice, little surprise for her when she returns victorious from battle. I'm sure she'll like it.

50020618.text: Alright, that should be everything. If you could just double-check — make sure nothing's missing.

50020619.text: Lemme see... Huh? What's this crate of juice doing here?

50020621.text: Seven years ago, when the Abyss attacked our tribe, Atea saved my brother's life. She never asked for anything in return, but I could never forget what she did for my family that day.

50020622.text: So, send her my regards, would you? And have fun!

50020623.text: Oh, we will! It's gonna be a party to remember! Thanks a lot, Yelafath!

50020624.text: Well, that's our shopping done. Let's head back.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the abandoned hot spring

50020702.text: Wow, this place cleaned up nice! You got the water unblocked, too! Good work.

50020703.text: I would hope so. We spent all day clearing out debris from the bottom of the spring.

50020705.text: Oh, we brought back tons of stuff. We set it down near the cave entrance.

50020706.text: Alright, then, roll up your sleeves, everyone, and let's get back to work!

50020707.text: #Actually, why don't you two take a break. I'll handle it from here. {NICKNAME}, mind lending me a hand?

50020710.text: So, I was brainstorming on the way over, and I'm thinking we could draw something on the wall over here, and the snacks and drinks can go over there...

50020711.text: Under Mualani's direction, you give the abandoned spring a new look...

50020712.text: So, what do you think? Not bad, right?

50020713.text: It looks amazing! Paimon had no idea you were such a great designer!

50020714.text: Well, I'm usually the one in charge of the family store, so I'm pretty good at things like renovation and organization.

50020715.text: Not to mention, this was totally a group effort... Still, I didn't expect it to take quite this long... Guess it's too late to invite Auntie Atea over, huh...

50020716.text: Yeah, tonight's definitely not gonna work. Chief Amina set up those patrols to guard against the Abyss, and Atea volunteered. So, she's on watch tonight.

50020717.text: I see. Well, guess the surprise will have to wait until tomorrow.

50020718.text: Hmm... This could actually be a good thing. She can relieve all the exhaustion of keeping watch all night by soaking in the hot spring! She's gonna love it!

50020719.text: #Well, let's call it a day, then! {NICKNAME}, Paimon, you must be tired, too. C'mon, I'll take you to the inn.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the inn to rest

50020801.text: Alright, this is it. Get a good night's sleep, okay? I'll see you tomorrow.

50020803.text: *yawn*... Paimon's exhausted. We really went all over the place today, didn't we?

50020804.text: Anyway, we need to be well-rested for the party tomorrow, so let's head inside!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go back to the inn and sleep
Deal with the unforeseen situation

50021003.text: *snore*... Huh? What's with all the noise...?

50021005.text: Mualani? What's going on... Ahhh, where did all these monsters come from!?

50021006.text: It's the Abyss. Our patrols are trying to drive them back as we speak.

50021007.text: Come with me. I'll take you somewhere safe!

50021008.text: Mualani, a little help over here? We can't hold 'em back much longer!

50021009.text: One moment. I'll be right there!

50021011.text: Really? That's perfect! I've been waiting for the chance to fight by your side!

50021014.text: Hang in there, we're here to help!

50021013.text: Couldn't have said it better myself!

subQuests.subQuestName: Repel the Abyss incursion
Talk to Mualani

50021201.text: We've cleared out most of the monsters over here. Thanks for your help — it would've taken me ages on my own.

50021202.text: Looks like we're still in for a long night, though. We still have no idea where these creatures are coming from...

50021203.text: Let's go ask Amina. She'll have a better handle on the situation.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go with Mualani to find Amina

50021302.text: Oh, It's you three... Thank you for helping clear out all those monsters.

50021303.text: We were prepared for an attack, but we didn't have enough people to prevent them from breaking through our defenses. No casualties so far, though.

50021304.text: Where'd they come from this time?

50021305.text: The east side. We've pinpointed the position of an Abyssal Pylon, but we don't have enough manpower to take it down.

50021307.text: A kind of "gate" created by the Abyss, one that allows monsters from the Night Kingdom to enter the physical world.

50021308.text: The only way to end the attack is to destroy the Pylon as soon as possible. Otherwise, the endless hordes of monsters will exhaust our defenses.

50021309.text: Exactly, that's what I'm most concerned about. Their numbers suggest there might even be multiple Pylons in the area. We're searching for them as we speak...

50021310.text: #Alright, we'll go seal off the one to the east. {NICKNAME}, Paimon, can I count on your help again?

50021311.text: Of course! We can't just sit back and do nothing!

50021312.text: On behalf of the People of the Springs, you have my thanks. We're counting on you.

50021313.text: Let's go, there's no time to lose. Take care, Amina.

subQuests.subQuestName: Destroy the Abyssal Pylon
Talk to Mualani

50021601.text: Phew, that should do it, right?

50021602.text: I don't see any more monsters, so looks like we're in the clear.

50021603.text: Do these attacks happen a lot? Must be hard on your tribe...

50021604.text: Yeah, it makes things hard sometimes, but that's how our ancestors have always lived.

50021605.text: Besides, the Abyss doesn't care how difficult our lives are. Fighting back is the only option.

50021606.text: C'mon, we should head back... Huh? What are you looking at? Is there something over there?

50021609.text: You're right! Mualani, look! They're coming from that direction!

50021610.text: Wait, that area looks kinda familiar...

50021611.text: That's the location of the abandoned spring!

50021612.text: Wh—What!? How unlucky can we get? We just finished the renovations!

50021613.text: We probably don't have any reinforcements over there, so it's up to us! Let's move!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the abandoned hot spring

50021702.text: Atea! What are you doing here? Where's the Pylon?

50021703.text: Hah, where do you think...? If I'm here, means that thing is long gone.

50021704.text: I was in a hurry, so it's not my best work. You should check if all the important stuff is still here.

50021705.text: Stop talking for now. That wound looks bad... The Abyssal power is corroding your body.

50021706.text: Is this the right area? Hello? Anyone there?

50021707.text: Mualani! And... Atea? What's going on? We were told the second Pylon was over here...

50021708.text: Atea took care of it, but she's injured... Quick, someone get a doctor!

50021709.text: Alright, alright, stop fussing. Don't you think I know my own limits? The main thing is, they didn't destroy anything. This is a beautiful hot spring, by the way. I can tell how much work you put into it.

50021710.text: Wait, no. This was meant to be... a surprise.

50021714.text: You think I couldn't tell you were avoiding me on purpose? Not one of you stopped to say hello today... It couldn't be more obvious that you were hiding something.

50021715.text: And you, Mualani. Were you the one that bought the snacks? How many times have I told you? You have to choose them based on the temperature of the water...

50021716.text: Oh, forget about that. The doctor's almost here, and you're gonna get all better. Then, we can have a meal together, and I'll help you make whatever you want, okay? You just have to hold on...

50021717.text: (Mualani said Atea had been injured by the Abyss before. Maybe that's why the corrosion is so fast this time...)

50021718.text: (At this rate, she's not going to make it until help arrives. Maybe there's something I can do.)

50021719.text: The impurities and the elemental energy we embody repel each other.

50021720.text: What!? The crystal has been purified!? When?

50021721.text: The anguish he feels... has brought him to tears...

50021722.text: I also came across a Teardrop Crystal. Can you purify it?

50021728.text: What is this? Some sort of purification? The Abyssal power... It's being cleansed away!

50021730.text: I never knew that was even possible...

50021734.text: The mark of the Abyss... It's gone...

50021735.text: #Yes, thanks to {NICKNAME}... By the way, are you alright?

50021736.text: I just saw you purify Abyssal power from Atea's body. That didn't injure you in any way, did it?

50021743.text: You scared us all half to death just now!

50021744.text: A group of young tribespeople race over to surround you and Atea.

50021745.text: They toss you into the air over and over, as if welcoming a triumphant hero.

50021746.text: Alright, everyone, head back and get some rest. We'll meet here tomorrow!

50021747.text: We'll celebrate Atea's recovery, and our triumph over the Abyss!

50021748.text: #And most importantly, we'll show {NICKNAME} and Paimon how grateful we are for their aid. Let's make it an occasion to remember! Dismissed!

50021750.text: Got any other secret powers I should know about, haha? But, seriously, you really came through for us tonight, so thank you.

50021751.text: Paimon almost forgot you had that ability. You used it back in Mondstadt to cleanse Dvalin's tears, didn't you?

50021752.text: #That was some quick thinking, {NICKNAME}... Huh? You look like something's bothering you. What's wrong?

50021753.text: (I didn't want to spoil the mood earlier, but when I was purifying the Abyssal power within Atea, I could sense something...)

50021754.text: (Remnants of that power have existed within her body for years, corroding it from the inside...)

50021755.text: (I did my best to cleanse that power just now, but it's already deeply ingrained within her internal organs, leaving her as fragile as a dried leaf in the wind.)

50021756.text: Abyssal power still exists within her body. Immersing herself in hot water would accelerate the corrosion of her internal organs and the progression of her illness.

50021757.text: We think Auntie Atea's illness has taken a turn for the better.

50021758.text: She could never come into contact with hot water before, and now she's visiting the hot springs every night. I mean, it's pretty obvious what that means, right?

50021759.text: (I don't think she was going to the hot springs because she was recovering, but because she realized her condition had taken a decisive turn for the worse... I'm just not sure if I should tell Mualani.)

50021760.text: #Hellooo! {NICKNAME}! Maybe you can zone out some other time, because Paimon can barely keep her eyes open. Let's head back for now.

subQuests.subQuestName: Take part in the hot springs party

50021801.text: Not interested in hanging out with the other kids?

50021803.text: Snacks not to your taste? Hot spring temperature too high?

50021804.text: ...None of the above, huh? I heard you were the one who cleansed the Abyssal power yesterday... You sensed it, didn't you?

50021806.text: *sigh* I was hoping to keep it a secret for a few more days, didn't want to ruin the celebrations and all, but looks like it was no use... Hey, kid!

50021808.text: Yes, you. C'mon, let's go for a walk.

50021809.text: Hey, where are you going? Did something happen?

50021810.text: Just going to get some air. It's too noisy in here.

50021811.text: You have fun — we'll be right back. Oh, and there are extra snacks in that box over there if they need replenishing. Baked them all fresh this the morning.

50021815.text: ...You've gotten so tall, you know that? Feels like just yesterday you were that rambunctious kid, causing trouble all around the hot springs. It's like all that time passed by in the blink of an eye...

50021816.text: Tell me, how are your parents?

50021817.text: They're away on business... Seriously, Atea, what's going on? You're acting strange...

50021818.text: #{NICKNAME}, did something happen? Both of you seem a little off today...

50021820.text: I wasn't visiting the hot springs because I was getting better. And that Pylon yesterday... I didn't go face it by myself because I was reckless, or too anxious to wait for reinforcements...

50021821.text: It's because my body isn't going to last much longer.

50021822.text: Your friend saved my life in that cave, and because of that, I got to enjoy this celebration with you all... But, I'm just a few days shy of the end.

50021823.text: The hot springs... I'm just trying to enjoy them for as long as I have left.

50021826.text: "That better not happen again, whether I'm here to catch you or not" — that's what you said back at the artificial spring. I... had a bad feeling then, but I didn't want it to be true.

50021827.text: I... wanted to believe you were actually recovering...

50021828.text: You wanna know something? Recovery, death... To me, the two aren't all that different. Both are worth celebrating.

50021829.text: You've never been resurrected, so you might not understand, but death and I? We're old pals by now. There's nothing sad about being reunited with an old friend.

50021830.text: I lived with regret for a long time... regret that my illness meant I could no longer take to the frontlines, especially as our nation slid deeper into crisis.

50021831.text: But, yesterday, I was finally able to let go of that regret. Not only because I found the strength to fight the Abyss, even at the end of my life... But because I got to see you in action, Mualani.

50021832.text: Seeing you out there... It made me realize that I don't need to worry about our tribe or our nation's future. You have the capacity to bring us all together.

50021833.text: Even if I was never injured, old age would still take me one day, but I've done what I needed to do — the future is in your hands now.

50021834.text: Just remember — whether in life or death, I am always with you.

50021835.text: I understand. Seems like you've given this a lot of thought, Atea. Thank you for telling me all this.

50021836.text: I'll do everything in my power to protect our tribe, our nation, and live up to the example you set for me.

50021837.text: Good... Oh, and, if any of you have the chance to meet with the Archon, could you give this to her for me?

50021839.text: A talisman I've carried with me my whole life. It may seem strange to say while I'm still alive, but just think of it as a "relic" I'm leaving for her.

50021840.text: It's brought me good fortune in battle. Even after I became too sick to fight, I never took it off.

50021841.text: Just tell her it "embodies fond memories and my strength of will." She'll know what I'm trying to say.

50021842.text: Don't worry... We'll make sure she gets it.

50021843.text: Alright, that's all I wanted to say. Let's head back to the party. No use spending what little time I have left being sad.

50021844.text: #{NICKNAME}, Atea, Mualani! If you don't hurry up, there won't be any snacks left!

50021845.text: Excuse me, what did I say about bathing in the hot springs on a full stomach? Hey, are you listening to me—

50021846.text: Everyone has a great time amid the festive atmosphere. When it comes time to go, Atea says goodbye with a smile.

50021847.text: When she reaches your group, she pats Mualani on the shoulder lightly.

50021848.text: "Life is a journey in which there's no turning back, so forge ahead and don't hold back."

subQuests.subQuestName: Additional
Additional
Additional

50023102.text: I've gotta deliver some ceremonial artifacts back to my tribe. I didn't place too well in this Pilgrimage, so, now that it's over, it's time to get home and get back to work.

50023104.text: Yeah. I got injured during the team round and wound up losing two key matches during individual competition — both against opponents I'd faced many times in the past. We've each had our fair share of wins and losses. It happens.

50023105.text: Haha, that's what you get for locking me away earlier! Get used to the taste of karma... May those injuries be the first of many!

subQuests.subQuestName: Additional

50023601.text: Phew... Thank you for your help. The Abyss has fled back to the Night Kingdom, and the water temperature's back to normal.

50023602.text: Guess that means we've got multiple things to celebrate at this party!

subQuests.subQuestName: Additional

50029701.text: With doubts still lingering in your heart, you return to the inn to rest until the next morning. Until it's time for the hot spring party...

subQuests.subQuestName: Additional

50029902.text: That's it, alright. C'mon, let's get rid of this thing!

50029903.text: Huh? Seems like the monsters are decreasing in number...
